question: Which context-dependency claims are justified now without turning direct syntax, finite replay samples, or definition opening into a stronger semantics than MTS currently accepts?

evidence.directDeixis: #157 shows ContextPronoun occurrence is a source-span-independent typed-AST fact
evidence.finiteReplay: #157 shows one explicit context pair can witness sensitivity while equal results on finitely many frames establish only finite-domain observational invariance
evidence.definitionClosure: #157 builds a terminating DefinitionId graph only by explicit open_definition calls; current interpret_constraints never performs that traversal automatically
evidence.interpreterBoundary: the interpreter is a link but only its explicit ContextFrame projection enters current evaluation semantics

models.name: no-direct-pronoun-means-universal-context-invariance
models.reason: Absence of ContextPronoun is a local typed-AST fact. Future accepted composition or explicitly opened definitions may carry context dependence, and no universal quantification over contexts has been justified.

models.name: finite-replay-sampling-proves-universal-context-invariance
models.reason: Equal replay on a finite serialized context set proves only observational invariance on that declared set.

models.name: typed-direct-deixis-plus-scoped-observational-evidence
models.reason: Expose direct typed-AST deixis as a precise static fact; keep replay sensitivity/invariance explicitly scoped to its context domain; never silently promote either to universal theoremhood.

models.name: definition-opening-closure-is-current-evaluation-semantics
models.reason: open_definition is an accepted separate one-step operation and interpret_constraints does not automatically open or recursively evaluate definitions.

models.name: definition-dependency-is-separate-static-relation
models.reason: A finite DefinitionId dependency graph is technically viable, but its normative meaning must be coordinated with accepted composition/dependency semantics rather than masquerading as current evaluation.

directAnalysis.meaning: the typed AST contains at least one ContextPronoun occurrence

replayEvidence.sensitivity: different canonical replay result for the same non-context inputs on an explicitly named pair/domain of ContextFrames
replayEvidence.finiteDomainInvariance: equal canonical replay result for all explicitly named frames in one finite domain
replayEvidence.resultEquality: success + grounded holes + aliases; trace remains diagnostic

requiredWhen: a claimed dependency requires unaccepted composition semantics
a referenced definition/dependency cannot be resolved under the declared analysis substrate
finite replay evidence is being asked to justify an unbounded invariance claim

productionCandidateForNextGate.scope: read-only direct typed-AST deictic analysis only

requiredQuestions: exact typed traversal over every current AST node
stable occurrence paths independent of SourceSpan/whitespace
whether Definition target and RHS are both traversed when analyzing a Definition AST itself
proof that the operation reads no MemoryView, DefinitionEnvironment, interpreter identity or policy
portable conformance vectors for zero/one/multiple/current/parent pronouns
